title: Make every mutating htmx request signal that it is in flight

facts.note: Bun/htmx stack workspace (atdd.workspace.bun). Applies to htmx markup wherever it appears (HTML files, templates, or markup embedded in source files); no file-kind restriction.

values: htmx_hypermedia_detector: element with hx-post|hx-put|hx-patch|hx-delete declaring neither hx-indicator nor hx-disabled-elt
facts.note: Detector scans all in-scope markup (not only the diff), so pre-existing violations and signals removed from still-mutating elements are covered; finding must be exposed as an activation fact.

values: markup containing an hx-post|hx-put|hx-patch|hx-delete attribute is touched, including removal of hx-indicator/hx-disabled-elt
facts.note: Diff-level observer for early firing; the finding fact remains authoritative for existing elements outside the diff.

fires: Any element (form, button, etc.), new or pre-existing, carries hx-post, hx-put, hx-patch or hx-delete and declares neither hx-indicator nor hx-disabled-elt.
An element's verb changes from hx-get to a mutating verb with no progress signal.
A progress signal is removed from an element that still issues a mutating request.
A mutating htmx element without a signal lives in markup embedded in a source/template file rather than a standalone HTML file.
doesNotFire: An element issuing only hx-get (idempotent read).
A mutating element that declares hx-indicator, hx-disabled-elt, or both.

given: An element issues a mutating htmx request (hx-post, hx-put, hx-patch or hx-delete), which changes server state so a duplicate is not harmless.
when: That element exists in the markup.
then: The element issuing the mutation declares a progress signal: hx-indicator or hx-disabled-elt (either satisfies; both is fine).
prefer: hx-disabled-elt (disables the control in flight, making double-submit impossible) where a duplicate is expensive, e.g. <form hx-post="…" hx-disabled-elt="find button">.
hx-indicator (spinner region in flight) to show something is happening, e.g. <form hx-post="…" hx-indicator="#spinner">.
avoid: <form hx-post="…">…</form> with no signal — invisible in flight.
hx-indicator alone where duplicates are expensive: it says wait but does not stop the user.
Treating a server idempotency key as an exemption: a real mitigation the rule cannot see.
Adding indicators to hx-get elements under this rule — a UX preference, out of scope.
unless: The element issues only hx-get (idempotent; a duplicate is harmless).
why: htmx swaps fragments in place with no navigation, so the page looks identical while in flight; users correctly read 'nothing happened', click again, and a non-idempotent request runs twice (duplicate orders, charges, rows).
evidence: htmx_hypermedia_detector reports no finding across the in-scope markup.
Every opening tag containing hx-post/hx-put/hx-patch/hx-delete also contains hx-indicator or hx-disabled-elt.
verifier_detail: Zero-dependency Bun detector: find each mutating verb attribute (hx-post, hx-put, hx-patch, hx-delete), extract the enclosing opening tag, flag the element when it declares neither hx-indicator nor hx-disabled-elt.
Deduplicate findings per element: an element carrying two mutating verbs reports once.
hx-get is not scoped. An element declaring both signals passes; only declaring neither is a violation.
Server-driven idempotency (idempotency key on the endpoint) is a real mitigation but invisible to the detector and does not exempt the element from signalling progress to the user.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.

Bun/htmx-stack realization of the agnostic "an in-flight mutation is observable" / "in-flight mutations are visible" obligation, enforced by the htmx_hypermedia_detector family implementation on atdd.workspace.bun.

Source rationale: this is the single most common user complaint about htmx applications and is not a taste issue; full-page navigation used to give a free progress signal (browser spinner, page going blank), swapping a fragment in place gives none.

Source fix_hint examples used endpoint "/orders": <form hx-post="/orders">…</form> ✗ invisible in flight; <form hx-post="/orders" hx-indicator="#spinner">…</form> ✓ shows progress; <form hx-post="/orders" hx-disabled-elt="find button">…</form> ✓ prevents re-submit.

sharedNodes.text: Strict disposition: the workspace (atdd-bun) fails on every finding; there is no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: Activation facts, fires and doesNotFire lists, including the explicit note that the rule covers all mutating elements (pre-existing included) and htmx markup embedded in any file kind.
additions.justification: Required by the target structure; derived from the source's universal scope ('Every element issuing a mutating htmx request'), the hx-get exclusion and the either/both signal clause.
Required structural field; restates the source's universal applicability without narrowing to changed elements.

additions.justification: Required structure; restates the source detector behaviour as a compliance check, no new obligation.
